name: Sauce Essentials Live Resin Disposable | Aurora
description:
The Dream Pen is formulated specifically for a great night’s sleep. Made with a blend of super indica Aurora, CBN, CBD and Liquid Diamonds, the Dream Pen is the perfect remedy to help users fall asleep and stay asleep. CBN, or Cannabinol, is a rare, minor cannabinoid found in the cannabis plant that is known for its ability to combat insomnia, inflammation, and pain. Don’t let insomnia ruin your nights, drift away with Dream Pen.
Taste: Blackberry, Herb Feel: Sleepy, Relaxed, Pain

Relief Strain: Afghan x Northern Lights
